map.为什么按周期天数匹配参考？: Why match references by cycle day count?
map.性激素随卵泡发育剧烈变化，同一数值在卵泡期与黄体期意义不同；按天数匹配阶段参考才: Sex hormones change sharply with follicular development, so the same value means different things in the follicular and luteal phases — only matching references by cycle day is accurate.
map.周期不规律怎么办？: What if the cycle is irregular?
map.周期不规律者单点激素难以定位阶段，宜结合阴道超声监测卵泡与内膜，或连续多周期评估: A single hormone point cannot locate the phase in irregular cycles; combine transvaginal ultrasound monitoring of follicles and endometrium, or assess over several consecutive cycles.
